**[P1] Run customer transforms outside the plugin lock**

`_emit()` is invoked while holding `self._lock`, and this call executes configured input/output transforms; `_build_operations()` similarly executes result overrides. Two overlapping invocations whose callbacks enter each other's plugin can therefore each hold one lock while waiting for the other, hanging both invocations. `_hook_frame` only defers drains and record releases, so it does not prevent this direct inversion. Snapshot and increment the revision under the lock, release it while invoking transforms, then reacquire it to revalidate and schedule atomically. Add a barrier-based reciprocal-reentry test.
